notes: Painted orange board on poles, Kuta, Bali; side list (HIGH SPEED CONNECTION, LCD 17", HEAD SET, WEB CAM) and window poster (High Speed 384 kbps, print/scan/CD) are distractors. 'Wank' is in script lettering.

author: shankar s.
attribution: Photo: shankar s., CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/77742560@N06/44632347072. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Header of the visitor-rules board at Borobudur temple: large 'CANDI BOROBUDUR' at left, ministry/conservation-office block at right. Below are 18 prohibition pictograms; the only other text is 'Official Permit is Required / Harus Dengan Izin Resmi' under the camera/drone panel and a tiny 'BEER' on a bottle.
source_title: Behavioural guidelines at Borobodur displayed at the start of the climb

author: shankar s.
attribution: Photo: shankar s., CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/77742560@N06/46049598692. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Roadside banner on bamboo poles by rice fields in Bali with a civet photo and a left arrow pointing to the coffee plantation. Round logo in the middle reads 'ONE BALI AGROWISATA' around the top and 'LUWAK COFFEE' along the bottom (small, curved).
source_title: Kopi Luwak centre- some people have questioned the ethics of this

author: shankar s.
attribution: Photo: shankar s., CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/77742560@N06/46099392071. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-lettered marker-pen directions on a laminated card taped to a black board, Campuhan Ridge walk near Ubud, Bali; a right arrow is drawn above. The printed photo strip at the top has small 'Karsa Kafe & Rice Terrace Villas' in red script and tiny 'Campuhan Ridge' / web address text; not transcribed. Preview is only 1024 px wide.
source_title: Ah refreshment after 2 km- that was probably the longest two km I have ever traversed!

author: ivanlanin
attribution: Photo: ivanlanin, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/81434456@N00/2778608898. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Market name board over the entrance, Yogyakarta. A red-and-white flag hides the R between BERINGHA and JO (full name Pasar Beringharjo); the line is transcribed as visible. A Javanese-script (Aksara Jawa) line under the name is not transcribed. Small address line: Jl. Jend. A. Yani 16, Yogyakarta. Crowd below is incidental.

author: GOC53
attribution: Photo: GOC53, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/30659367@N00/5514377743. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Brown heritage-site board with leaf shadows across it, Bedulu, Gianyar, Bali. A Balinese-script line under the site name is not transcribed. Small footer (DILINDUNGI: UNDANG-UNDANG NO.5 TAHUN 1992; BALAI PELESTARIAN PENINGGALAN PURBAKALA BALI ...) omitted.

author: JasonParis
attribution: Photo: JasonParis, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/94064020@N00/6231398067. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Faded yellow photo-shop fascia on a corrugated wall, Seminyak, Bali; power lines cross the signs. Tiny 'QUALITY MONITORING SERVICE' under EXPRESS is not transcribed.

author: nSeika
attribution: Photo: nSeika, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/33542052@N07/8217953027. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Arrow-shaped black board with white letters seen from above through a footbridge railing (film photo, grain and dust). Third line is in smaller condensed letters. A 'SOTO AYAM' stall banner behind is a distractor; a tiny line under 'JAKARTA BARAT' is illegible.

author: JasonParis
attribution: Photo: JasonParis, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/94064020@N00/6231373181. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large blue letters painted on a white wall at Echo Beach, Canggu, Bali; third line is a tagline. Parked scooters in the foreground; number plate on the right scooter is small and not the subject.

author: D-Stanley
attribution: Photo: D-Stanley, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/79721788@N00/6336844763. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Red jewellery-shop fascia in Kampung Arab, Denpasar, seen at an angle above the shop door. 'Sakura' is large and clear; the small address/phone line beneath ('JALAN ... No. 47 Telp. (0361) ...') is too small to read reliably and only its last word 'DENPASAR' is transcribed. Distractors: 'ISTANA MAS' fascia and vertical banners at left, a house number '47', Coca-Cola crates. Men seated in the foreground are incidental to the street scene.

author: ivanlanin
